mostWorthwhile.text: Building the two kinds of proteins was most worthwhile because the pictures showed muscle cells keeping pulling fibres inside while supporting cells built material around themselves.

leastWorthwhile.text: The second messenger-to-RNA step felt somewhat repetitive after the muscle path, though it helped make the comparison clear.

surprise.text: I was surprised that cells with the same DNA could use different instructions and put their proteins in different places.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary: the messenger pictures named the target genes, and amino acids were identified as protein building blocks.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter to see how these different cells become part of larger body structures, although this chapter's two paths were fairly predictable.
